page.overview:
Who is Therese?

Therese appears in the Street Fighter animated series episode Eye of the Beholder. She is one of Vega's servants. While massaging his back, he compliments her on her looks. He also shows jealousy, claiming that she may one day become more beautiful than he is.

She tries to console him and claims that he is still better looking than her. He still isn't convinced and threatens to kill Therese with his claw, causing her to run away in fear.
